repair.title: Fewer Girls Became Child Brides
repair.summary: UNICEF reports that the share of young women married as children fell from about one in four a decade ago to about one in five.
repair.why_it_matters: Delayed marriage can protect girls' schooling, health, autonomy, and childhood.
repair.caveat: Progress is too slow for the 2030 goal, and conflict can quickly reverse gains.
